answer: Each identity must finish a one-hour voyage down a delay chain. It starts from the willow beacon seed; each hash needs the last, so no rig shortens one. Every 600 steps it posts an umber checkpoint; auditors recheck any checkpoint, and matching checkpoints expose a rented-chain ring and void both chains. One rig-hour costs 45 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 45,000 against a 40,000 pool, a 5,000 loss. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep full shares.
